verdict.rationale: Qodo's governance docs, aimed at engineering leaders, describe an org-level view with a 'complete history of findings, decisions, and codebase health' and enforcement of standards across every repository. That points to some centralized findings reporting, but nothing shows actual dashboards of acceptance rates or review coverage. Missing for 10: explicit dashboards/analytics UI, acceptance-rate metrics, review-coverage metrics across repos/teams, independent or hands-on corroboration.
